meta.route: http://localhost:4200/ (main feed, tags route, 21 fixture posts)
meta.environment: Linux cloud VM (Ubuntu), Playwright Chromium headless-shell 151, MariaDB, Go API/CDNs, Node frontend dev server (node index.js)
meta.harness: speed-lab/harness/measure.mjs — per run: fresh browser (cold nav) then reload (warm); medians; settle 2500ms
meta.metrics: coldLoad/warmLoad = loadEventEnd; FCP/LCP via paint + largest-contentful-paint observers; feedPaint = first post card revealed with decoded thumbnail (cards animate from opacity:0 so LCP attributes to text, not thumbnails)
